seo.title: Carlsbad Village's Rooftop Bar, BBQ & Game Day Headquarters
seo.description:
PRK 101 is a modern American, bi-level restaurant in Carlsbad Village. Known as North County’s game day headquarters, we bring together California coastal energy, country spirit, and big screen sports in a high-energy rooftop setting.
Signature California tri tip anchors a menu of elevated American comfort food and shareable plates built for groups, alongside craft beer and signature cocktails. Whether you’re here for NFL Sundays, Padre games, UFC fight nights, fantasy drafts, or sunset drinks on the rooftop, PRK 101 delivers the ultimate sports and social dining experience.
By day, the rooftop captures laid-back coastal vibes. By night, the interior transforms into North County’s stadium atmosphere during major sporting events.
This is where community gathers to watch, celebrate, and return every week.

Where Coast Meets Country.

venue.heading:
Rooftop.
Courtyard.
Indoor Bar.
venue.body: Three distinct spaces under one open sky. The central courtyard with the massive LED wall. The elevated rooftop deck with views of Carlsbad Village. The indoor bar with wall-to-wall screens and long communal tables. One block from the beach.

smokehouse.heading:
Smoked Low.
Served Right.
smokehouse.body: Brisket. Ribs. Pulled pork. All wood-smoked the right way. Served on a tray with pickles, bread, and sauce — the way it was meant to be eaten. No shortcuts, no compromises.

drinks.heading:
Cold Drinks.
Big Selection.
drinks.body: Signature cocktails, frozen margaritas, local craft beers on draft, and the Rodeo Tower — Park 101's most celebrated creation.

events.heading:
Live Music.
Every Week.
events.body: Country nights. Live bands. Padres watch parties. UFC fight nights. From kickoff to the final buzzer, from the first song to last call — something's always happening at Park 101.

brunch.heading: Brunch on the Rooftop
brunch.body: Open-air rooftop. Smoked brisket chilaquiles. Breakfast burritos loaded with tri-tip. Rodeo Tower mimosas. The best way to spend a Saturday morning in Carlsbad Village.
